damping.stiffness_matrix: initial elastic tangent including k0 horizontal isolator tangent

modeling_assumptions.frame: 2D Euler-Bernoulli elastic beam-column stiffness, 3 DOF per node before diaphragm reduction.
modeling_assumptions.mass: Only specified lumped floor mass is assigned to horizontal floor DOFs; steel density is recorded but not added as self-mass.
modeling_assumptions.constraints: At each floor, the three horizontal DOFs are transformed to one rigid-diaphragm coordinate; vertical translations and rotations remain independent.
modeling_assumptions.isolation: Three horizontal Bouc-Wen isolators and three vertical linear springs connect top isolator nodes to fixed ground.
modeling_assumptions.story_drift: Story 1 drift uses floor-1 diaphragm displacement minus average top-of-isolator displacement divided by story height.
modeling_assumptions.base_shear: Total base shear is the sum of the three positive-resisting horizontal isolator forces.
modeling_assumptions.coordinates: All output displacements are relative to ground in the frame x direction.
